categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 机器人操作与世界模型是主战场，LLM正外溢到量子线路、MoE路由与ML工程自动化。

articles.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
articles.summary: 如果你在做机器人操作策略，得注意现有评测基本都在通用任务上刷分，个性化偏好这块几乎是空白，这个benchmark很可能是下一个必刷项
articles.author: Zhixu Li, Keqian Tang 等
articles.body: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. The code, datasets, and demos can be found on the project website: https://libero-perm.github.io/.
articles.bodyZh: 个性化（personalization）对通用机器人（general-purpose robots）真正走进家庭、变得实用来说，是绕不开的一环。通用机器人操作（robotic manipulation）已经研究得很多了，但个性化机器人操作（PeRM）还缺一个受控基准（controlled benchmark），能把“任务有没有完成”和“偏好有没有满足”分开来评。我们推出 LIBERO-PeRM，一个用来研究具身智能体（embodied agents）偏好学习的基准（benchmark）。它围绕五个问题展开：1）在零样本（zero-shot）场景下，策略（policies）会不会按偏好来；2）策略怎么从演示（demonstrations）里学会单个偏好；3）演示越多，学偏好的效率怎么样；4）学到的偏好能不能跨布局、跨任务泛化；5）策略怎么组合偏好，遇到冲突时又会怎么表现。我们提出了一套受控的建模方式和分类法，用来描述仿真里能观察到的偏好，覆盖动作、技能和用户画像上的选择。这个框架只限定在能用语言表达、能在 LIBERO 里不改变任务目标就实例化、能自动评估、还能跨任务复用的偏好上。基于 LIBERO，我们的流程化数据管线会成对生成带偏好和不带偏好的演示。我们做了五个任务套件（共 312 个任务），里面有高质量演示、丰富元数据和偏好满足度指标。实验发现，现在的 VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）策略在零样本个性化上还挺吃力，而 SFT（监督微调）能让偏好变得可学。混合训练比顺序适配更能保住无偏好能力，并且在有上下文提示时比只训偏好表现更好，但可能削弱动作偏好的学习；偏好的泛化、拆解和冲突处理仍然很难。代码、数据集和演示都在项目网站：https://libero-perm.github.io/。

articles.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
articles.summary: 如果你以为LLM只能写代码调参，这篇直接把LLM塞进量子线路搜索里搜出了SOTA结构，值得看它怎么设计搜索空间和验证方式
articles.author: Andi Gu, Alek H. Kemeny 等
articles.body: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. In seven of the eight tasks, the discovered circuits significantly reduce both Toffoli and qubit counts relative to the state of the art. In the eighth, the search discovers a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion. By handling reversibility differently, the architecture makes divsteps -- a classical algorithm previously impractical for reversible integer arithmetic -- viable and substantially improves the Toffoli-qubit trade-off for modular inversion. These results open the door for evaluator-guided LLM co-design of new algorithmic structures for quantum computation.
articles.bodyZh: 目前，人们正把大量精力投入到大型量子信息处理器（large-scale quantum information processors）的实现上，但要想真正拿到有用的量子优势（quantum advantage），还得把高效的量子算法（quantum algorithms）做出来。很多实际问题里，最占资源的主要是一小撮计算原语（computational primitives），可要在量子场景下把它们优化好，会碰上一些独有的难题，其中一个就是普通经典计算里没有的可逆性约束（reversibility constraint）。为此，我们提出了一套进化框架（evolutionary framework）：由大语言模型（LLMs）来提电路设计，再让一个独立评估器（independent evaluator）去验证并打分。我们把这套框架用在了数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟和数论这些任务上。在八个任务中的七个里，找出来的电路相比当前最好水平（state of the art），都明显减少了 Toffoli 门数（Toffoli counts）和量子比特数（qubit counts）。在第八个任务里，搜索找到了一种新的可逆架构（reversible architecture），用来做素数域模逆（prime-field modular inversion）。这个架构换了一种方式处理可逆性，让 divsteps——一种以前在可逆整数算术（reversible integer arithmetic）里根本不实用的经典算法——变得可行，还大幅改善了模逆在 Toffoli 和量子比特之间的取舍（Toffoli-qubit trade-off）。这些结果给用评估器引导 LLM 来共同设计（evaluator-guided LLM co-design）量子计算的新算法结构打开了大门。

articles.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
articles.zh: T2-z：机器人世界模型环境隐变量的测试时优化
articles.summary: 如果你在跑机器人world model被sim-to-real偏差卡住，这篇提示不一定要重训，测试时调一下环境隐变量就能补上
articles.author: Chenyuan Zhou, Yining Hong 等
articles.body: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.
articles.bodyZh: 要预测世界会怎么回应一个动作，光靠眼睛能看到的东西还不够：机器人必须把那些既不能直接观察、也没有被明确写出来的环境因素考虑进去，从摩擦、质量这类物理属性，到人类设定的环境规则，都算在内。为此，我们提出了 T2-Z，用测试时优化（test-time optimization）来估计环境潜变量（environment latents），给机器人世界模型（world model）加上一个可学习的环境潜变量，用它来给世界预测提供条件。这个紧凑的潜变量不需要监督信号，也不需要知道到底有哪些环境因素、它们取什么值，就能捕捉环境背后的变化。训练时，T2-Z 会在两个阶段之间来回切换：一个是世界模型优化阶段，固定潜变量，学习跨环境的一般性动作条件动力学（action-conditioned dynamics）；另一个是环境潜变量优化阶段，冻结世界模型，只优化条件潜变量，让潜变量结构完全通过世界预测自己长出来。到了测试时，世界模型保持冻结，新初始化一个环境潜变量，用一次或多次测试时交互来优化它，让模型适应以前没见过的环境配置。在 7 个模拟设置和 4 个真实机器人任务上，T2-Z 把物体预测误差指标从 15.20 降到 7.00，把动作成功率从 33.73% 提高到 72.96%。它自发形成的潜变量，能在各种视觉场景里把单独因素和复合因素的结构化表示捕捉出来。消融实验（ablation）还表明，T2-Z 哪怕只靠一条测试时交互轨迹（trajectory），也能高效推断出环境潜变量。

articles.title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
articles.zh: CoDA：数据引擎与动作策略的协同演化
articles.summary: 如果你愁机器人数据不够、策略上不去，这篇的思路是让数据采集和策略互相喂，把单向流水线变成正循环
articles.author: Tianjiao Yu, Zhilin Ou 等
articles.body: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.
articles.bodyZh: 生成式仿真（generative simulation）能自动搭建机器人训练环境，但物理上说得通的环境，不一定真有助于训练。难点在于：得找出能暴露策略（policy）失败的环境，以及能帮它克服这些失败的监督信号。为此我们提出 CoDA 框架：让仿真数据引擎（simulation data engine）和动作策略（action policy）通过一份共享的异构记忆（heterogeneous memory）共同演化，这份记忆里记录着环境搭建、策略失败和学习进展。记忆会把视觉语言评论器（vision-language critic）给出的、经过验证的诊断，转成两类程序：一类是生成程序（generation programs），用来把难点重现出来；一类是训练程序（training programs），帮策略跨过这些坎。我们还提出 Text2potential，把这些诊断转成分阶段的势函数（staged potentials），用于动作块价值学习（action-chunk value learning）；在标准奖励塑形（shaping）假设下，它既能给策略更新提供密集监督（dense supervision），又能保住任务的最优策略（optimal policy）。实测出来的学习进展，会指导下一步的环境生成和程序细化。在四类操作任务上，CoDA 把分布外成功率（out-of-distribution success）从监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）后的 5.3% 提到 27.6%，在相同生成预算（generation budget）下比最强的闭环基线（closed-loop baseline）高 9.5 个百分点。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，15 轮生成和训练把位置扰动（position perturbations）下的成功率从 25% 提到 84%，把指令扰动（instruction perturbations）下的成功率从 1% 提到 76%。

articles.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
articles.zh: OmniVerifier-C1：面向规则约束生成式世界建模的分解式分级验证器
articles.summary: 如果你用生成模型做世界模型又怕它违反规则，这个验证器把判定拆细、给出分级分数，比一刀切的通过/不通过信息量大得多
articles.author: Bowei Liu, Xinchen Zhang 等
articles.body: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.
articles.bodyZh: 生成式视觉验证器（Generative visual verifiers）对推进多模态智能（multimodal intelligence）特别关键。为了让视觉验证器在涉及组合性要求（compositional requirements）的复杂多模态场景里更稳、更可靠，我们不再停留在传统那种只给“真/假”离散判断的二元验证器（binary verifiers），而是引入一种新验证器：它能自动把复杂提示或环境规则拆成细粒度组件，再给每个组件逐点打分（pointwise scores），从而提供连续、信息量更丰富的评价信号。实验还表明，这种结构化、可解释的输出，能提升验证器在域外多模态评价任务上的泛化能力。为了训练这个验证器，我们提出一种解耦强化学习训练策略（Decoupled RL training strategy），把子问题级别的二元判断和全局对齐评分放在一起优化，用精确的局部反馈来培养细粒度验证能力，为全局层面可靠的连续打分打下基础。在通用强化学习框架下，我们先从实验上证明：所提出的逐点评分验证器（pointwise graded verifier）在传统文生图场景里明显优于二元验证器。接着我们把研究扩展到规则驱动的生成式世界建模（world modeling）：在有明确规则的情况下，用生成模型来做世界模拟（world simulation）和世界推理（world reasoning）。从理论上，我们还进一步说明：当有真值图像（ground-truth images）可用时，成对验证范式（pairwise verification paradigm）给出的评价比逐点形式更准确；而我们在迷宫、数独等不同结构化世界建模任务上的实验结果，也进一步验证了这套方法的有效性。总的来说，这些发现指向一个关键结论：生成模型要迈向结构化的世界建模智能体，关键就在于能不能拿到准确的成对评分视觉验证器。

articles.title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
articles.zh: 重新审视现代MoE中的路由探索
articles.summary: 如果你训MoE遇到专家塌缩、路由不探索，这篇把"探索"这件事重新拆了一遍，先看它的结论再改你的路由损失
articles.author: Bingcong Li, Hao Ma 等
articles.body: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. MirrorMoE is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts. MirrorMoE consistently improves performance across model scales.
articles.bodyZh: 混合专家（Mixture-of-experts, MoE）模型已经成了扩大模型参数规模的一条重要路子。现在这类 MoE 架构越来越喜欢把两个设计放在一起用：一个是细粒度专家切分（fine-grained expert segmentation），另一个是共享专家（shared experts）。前者的好处是，在激活比例不变的情况下，能组合出更多专家，从而提升表达能力；后者则是引入一批对每个 token 都生效的专家。我们发现，这两种设计之间其实有个“探索困境”：共享专家会降低 token 表示（token representations）的变化程度，让路由（routing）变得没那么爱探索。可细粒度专家切分又把路由空间组合式地放大了，反而更需要探索。结果就是，细粒度切分本来能带来的额外表达能力，在实际中可能没法完全发挥出来。为此我们提出 MirrorMoE，通过按 token 自适应地抑制（token-adaptive suppression）那些没必要参与的专家，把探索空间（exploration space）缩小，从而缓解这个探索困境。MirrorMoE 在不同模型规模上都能稳定提升表现。

articles.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
articles.summary: 如果你好奇AI落地为什么总卡在最后一步，这篇把"最后一公里"做成了可训练、可评估的环境，而不是继续当经验之谈
articles.author: Dongxu Yang, Hongda Yan 等
articles.body: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.
articles.bodyZh: 现在的智能体基准测试（agent benchmarks）通常评估的是那些定义得很清楚的任务，比如由问题报告、规格文档或者任务工单描述出来的任务。但真实世界的客户交付完全不是这么回事：一线交付工程师（forward-deployed engineers，简称 FDEs）得把模糊的需求问明白，得在正在运行的系统里干活，还得把那些没人明说的限制条件挖出来。我们推出了 FDE-Gym，这是一个包含 95 个端到端交付任务的基准测试，覆盖 18 个行业、20 个客户场景，每个任务都由行业专家根据真实交付项目改编。在模拟客户环境里，有按脚本行动的干系人（stakeholders），客户系统也可以修改，智能体要跟这些干系人沟通，在类似生产环境的系统上操作，最后交出一个能用的方案。FDE-Gym 给交付打分，看它把客户自己的成功指标（success metric）提升了多少；分数会做归一化（normalized），0 代表系统没变化，1 代表达到参考方案（reference solution）。同时，跟干系人互动也要扣分，比如发消息、试运行和等待时间。我们还搭了个在线平台，让人也能用同一套评分标准练 FDE 技能。我们评测了来自 7 家提供商的 13 种模型配置（model configurations）。在必须自己发现那些没明说限制的真实设定里，表现最好的配置平均只拿到 0.56 分，95 个任务里只解决了 14 个——这里的解决，是指分数至少 0.8，而且过程中没出事故（incident）。发现没明说的限制是最大瓶颈：一旦没有明确提示、要模型自己把这些限制挖出来，表现就会明显掉下来。但光把信息挖出来，还解释不了这个差距：就算在那 23 个任务里，最好的配置已经从干系人那里拿到了所有关键事实，也只有 10 个任务能把归一化后的业务提升（business uplift）做到 0.8 以上。这些结果说明，会解那些定义清楚的任务，跟给真实客户交付一套真正好用的 AI 系统，中间还差着一大截。

articles.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
articles.zh: MLExpert：面向自主机器学习工程的通用Agentic模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做AutoML Agent，这篇是往全流程自主做机器学习工程推的通用模型，可以对照看它究竟走到了哪一步
articles.author: Shangheng Du, Jinxin Shi 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.
articles.bodyZh:
现在，大语言模型（LLMs）的用途正在从帮人做科研、做工程，扩展到自己去开发和改进 AI 系统，也就是推进 AI for AI（AI4AI），把它当成通往递归式自我改进（RSI）的一条路。工作流驱动的机器学习工程（MLE）系统，靠复杂的编排来管理长周期实验，为这个目标提供了一条比较实际的路；而最近的 MLE 系统开始让模型自己主导交互，模型能自己安排实验，还能根据执行反馈调整优化策略。可问题是，每次实验拿到的反馈，其实都受前面好几步决策影响，而一次长时间的 MLE 运行里，又包含很多这种成本很高的实验。所以训练时，得从很长的交互轨迹里挑出有用的监督信号，还得能从中间结果里学到东西。

我们提出了一种后训练（post-training）方法，专门做自主的长周期 MLE 优化，并用它训练了 MLExpert——一个 350 亿参数的混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）智能体模型。我们设计了 Kaggle-MLE Factory，用来构造可执行任务，也搭了一个交互框架，让模型能自己主导实验。分层智能体监督微调（SFT）通过结果导向的监督，把通用的工具使用和编程能力迁移到 MLE 上。窗口化交互强化学习（WIRL）把相邻两次实验结果之间的多轮决策看成一个“执行窗口”，给它一个共享的、基于结果的奖励。异步采集和策略校正，让策略在整条轨迹结束前就能更新。在 MLE-Bench Lite 上，MLExpert 把基座模型的平均奖牌率从 37.9% 提到 72.7%，表现已经能和 Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3 这类更大的前沿模型掰手腕。进一步实验还显示，MLExpert 在 NatureBench Lite、智能体脚手架优化（agent scaffold optimization）和算法优化上也有提升，说明它学到的优化能力能泛化到其他任务。
